actor_resource_policy.reservation_semantics: A job reserves actual actor and vehicle IDs exclusively. Port capacities are not extra drivers. Resource waits and travel appear in source-labelled event timelines.

conveyor.direction_policy: Main one-way East→West; spur direction changes only by source lease/event. Preserve cargo initial yaw offset on reverse; curve tangent is continuous. T changes direction by explicit .8s stopped pivot, not through rail.

blueprint.origin: Floor centre of complete unloaded operating footprint, including forks and steered tyres.

steering.meaning: ICR is lateral R=wheelbase/tan(virtual angle), on the front axle plane. This is not an in-place spin. All steered tyre extents must stay inside the stated operating bounds; actual path/model acceptance remains later.
steering.model: Synthetic low-speed rear-steer bicycle bound with Ackermann wheel-angle reconciliation

cradle_assumption.meaning: Geometric cradle candidate only. Two fork pockets transfer load to a restrained cradle; two distant pads support the long bundle. No bending or payload capacity is inferred from these dimensions.
required_C08_checks: actual gross load plus cradle mass and centre of gravity
rated forklift capacity at actual load centre/height
cradle rating and approved support span/end overhang for this bundle
positive fork-pocket/attachment lock and load restraint
compatible pickup/setdown support and actual approach trajectory

load_profile.meaning: 4.2m long axis is across the forks, not along travel. Whole vehicle/load may yaw together; relative load yaw/tilt is not allowed by this profile.

nonlong_access_profile.meaning: Actual R03 heavy/pallet/IBC/drum/fragile sizes are enclosed without resizing. No LONG cradle; actual support/C08 approval still required.
